propositions: The import-linter job in _optionality.yml consumes a scarce concurrent slot but provides redundant test coverage already delivered by matrix cells in _build-and-test.yml

Deletion of the import-linter job must be paired with a durable, checked-in collection assertion to prevent future contributors from inadvertently removing the optionality guard via markers or file moves

The collection guard test must verify that tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py and tests/unit/test_optional.py collect exactly 9 items under the default suite selection with -m not integration and not external
Existing tests in test_ci_workflow_parity.py and check_verify_gate_parity.py have no visibility into _optionality.yml inner jobs and will pass unchanged after deletion without additional checks
The infra/github/main-protection.snapshot.json snapshot carries a stale required_status_check context for the deleted import-linter job that must be removed to prevent rollback failures
